title: Design Video Sharing Platform
summary: Design a video platform with upload, remove, watch, like, dislike, getLikesAndDislikes and getViews. upload assigns the smallest free nonnegative id; remove frees it; watch returns the substring between two minute indexes and increments views for an existing video.
inputFormat: upload takes video content; remove, like, dislike, getLikesAndDislikes and getViews take a video id; watch takes an id and start and end minute indexes.
outputFormat: Return values depend on the method; the missing-video sentinels are not recorded.
tieRules: Smallest free id is reused after removal.
edgeRules: The missing-video sentinel for each method and the watch substring bounds are not recorded.
factsMissing: Sentinel return for each method when the video is absent
Return types of getLikesAndDislikes and getViews
questions: What sentinel does each method return when the video id is absent (for example for watch, getLikesAndDislikes and getViews)?
What are the watch minute bounds, and does watch clamp an end index beyond the content?
